title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 2: the sons of Israel and the line of Judah, from Perez and Zerah to Jesse, David and the families of Caleb.

questions.text: Who was Judah's firstborn, who was wicked in Yahweh's sight?
questions.explanation: Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh's sight, and he killed him.

questions.text: Who bore Perez and Zerah to Judah?
questions.explanation: Tamar, Judah's daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah.

questions.text: Who is called "the troubler of Israel"?
questions.explanation: The son of Carmi was Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

questions.text: How is Nahshon described in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah.

answers.text: Prince of the children of Judah

questions.text: Which of Jesse's sons is listed as the seventh?
questions.explanation: Jesse's sons are counted from Eliab the firstborn to Ozem the sixth and David the seventh.

questions.text: Who were the sons of Zeruiah?
questions.explanation: Jesse's daughters were Zeruiah and Abigail, and the sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

questions.text: Who was the father of Amasa?
questions.explanation: Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

questions.text: How many cities did Jair have in the land of Gilead?
questions.explanation: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

questions.text: Sheshan had no sons. To whom did he give his daughter as wife?
questions.explanation: Sheshan had an Egyptian servant named Jarha, and he gave his daughter to Jarha as wife; she bore him Attai.

questions.text: Which families lived at Jabez, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 55 names the families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites and the Sucathites.
